neutral.EN: You did? What happened after that?
neutral.TL: Talaga? Ano ang nangyari pagkatapos noon?

neutral.EN: How did you manage to get through it?
Did anyone else make it out with you?
neutral.TL: May iba pa bang nakaligtas kasama mo?

neutral.EN: Where did you go once that went down?
neutral.TL: Saan ka pumunta nang mangyari iyon?

neutral.EN: What made you think of that just now?
neutral.TL: Bakit mo biglang naisip iyon ngayon?

neutral.EN: Were there many casualties back then?
neutral.TL: Marami bang nasawi noong panahong iyon?

neutral.EN: What did you end up doing about it?
neutral.TL: Ano ang naging aksyon mo tungkol doon?

neutral.EN: That sounds intense. What came next?
Did you ever go back to that place?
neutral.TL: Bumalik ka pa ba sa lugar na iyon kailanman?

warm.EN: Really? Tell me more about that.
warm.TL: Talaga? Kuwento mo pa sa akin.

warm.EN: That sounds like quite a memory. How did it feel?
warm.TL: Mukhang napakagandang alaala. Anong naramdaman mo?

warm.EN: I'd love to hear the rest of that story if you want to share.
warm.TL: Gusto kong marinig ang karugtong ng kuwento kung nais mong ibahagi.

warm.EN: It must have taken real courage. How did you hold up?
warm.TL: Kailangan ng tunay na tapang doon. Paano mo kinaya?

warm.EN: You went through so much. I'm glad you're here to talk about it.
warm.TL: Napakalaki ng pinagdaanan mo. Mabuti at narito ka para ikuwento.

warm.EN: Were you able to save anything from back then?
warm.TL: May naisalba ka ba mula noong panahong iyon?

warm.EN: I'm listening, friend. Take all the time you need.
warm.TL: Nakikinig ako, kaibigan. Huwag kang magmadali.

warm.EN: That sounds like someone who mattered deeply to you.
warm.TL: Mukhang may taong napakahalaga sa 'yo sa kuwentong 'yan.

warm.EN: What a journey. What kept you holding on?
warm.TL: Napakalaking paglalakbay. Ano ang nagpatatag sa 'yo?

warm.EN: Thank you for trusting me with that memory. What happened next?
warm.TL: Salamat sa pagtitiwala sa akin ng alaalang 'yan. Ano sumunod?

guarded.EN: Why are you telling me that?
guarded.TL: Bakit mo sinasabi sa akin iyan?

guarded.EN: What's the point of bringing that up now?
guarded.TL: Anong layunin sa pagbubukas niyan ngayon?
Sinusubukan mo ba ang magiging reaksyon ko?

guarded.EN: Who else knows about that story?
guarded.TL: Sino pa ang nakakaalam ng kuwentong 'yan?

guarded.EN: Why share something so personal with me?
guarded.TL: Bakit mo ibinabahagi ang ganyang personal na bagay sa akin?

guarded.EN: Sounds like an angle. What do you really want?
guarded.TL: Mukhang may pakay ka. Ano ba talaga ang gusto mo?

guarded.EN: Does that story have anything to do with our safety here?
guarded.TL: May kinalaman ba ang kuwentong 'yan sa kaligtasan natin dito?

guarded.EN: Be careful what details you hand out to people.
guarded.TL: Mag-ingat ka sa mga detalyeng ipinamamahagi mo sa iba.

guarded.EN: Are you trying to gauge where my loyalties lie?
guarded.TL: Sinusubukan mo bang alamin kung kanino ako tapat?

guarded.EN: Keep your personal history to yourself.
guarded.TL: Itago mo na lang sa sarili mo ang sarili mong nakaraan.
